# Case study — template

Length: 600–1,200 words, plus a 1-page PDF for sales. Job: prove results with a named customer.
Rule: no case study goes live without a signed release from the customer (gate `content.customer_release`).
Rule: every number comes from the customer or the client's own data. No invented quotes (FTC fake reviews rule and all markets).

---

**Title**: How {Customer} {achieved result with a number} with {Client product}
**Customer**: {name}, {industry}, {size}, {market}
**Products used**: {list}
**Interview**: {customer contact name, role}, recorded {date}

## At a glance (box)
| Challenge | Solution | Result |
|---|---|---|
| {1 sentence} | {1 sentence} | {1–3 numbers, for example "38% less time on X in 6 months"} |

## The customer
> 2–3 sentences: who they are and why the reader should care.

## The challenge
> What was broken, what it cost them, what they tried before. Use a quote from the customer.

## Why they chose {Client}
> 2–3 reasons. Use the customer's words.

## The solution
> What they did, in steps, with dates. Name the people involved if the release allows it.

## The results
> 3 results, each with a number, a time period and the source of the number.

> "{Approved customer quote}" — {Name}, {Role}, {Customer}

## What is next
> 1–2 sentences on future plans.

**CTA**: {See how {Client} can do this for you: demo link.}

---

## Release checklist (gate `content.customer_release`)
- [ ] Customer approves the full text, every number and every quote.
- [ ] Customer approves use of name, logo and photos, and in which markets.
- [ ] Release has an end date or "no end date".
- [ ] Release is stored in the engine with the approval item.

## Sales one-pager (1 page)
- Logo, at-a-glance box, 1 quote, 3 results, CTA, QR code to the full story.

## Repurpose pack
- 1 email for sales to send, 3 social posts, 1 short video script (testimonial format, Service 3), 1 slide for the sales deck, 1 ABM version for the same industry (Service 8).
